entities.text: M. Alwal Reddy vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice E.V. Venugopal
 Criminal Petition No.9920 Of 2023
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed seeking to quash the proceedings against petitioner/accused in F.I.R.No.89 of 2023 on the file of the Station House Officer, I.S. Sadan Police Station, Hyderabad for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 323, 420, 376 of I.P.C.
2.
Heard Mr.Pranay Bahuguna, learned counsel representing Mr.Rajesh Maddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.E.Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent No.1-State.

3. Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor, by filing the letter dated 07.04.2025 addressed by the Sub-Inspector of Police, I.S. Sadan Police Station, Hyderabad City submits that investigation is completed and charge sheet has been laid vide S.C.No.512 of 2024 on the file of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Nampally and hence, no further orders are required in this Criminal Petition.

entities.text: I.S. Sadan Police Station, Hyderabad City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Therefore, he seeks to dismiss this Criminal Petition as infructuous.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner concedes to the said request.
5. Recording the submissions of both the learned counsel and taking the copy of the letter dated 07.04.2025 onto the file, this Criminal Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
The petitioner is granted liberty to work out the remedies as available under law.

Miscellaneous Petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
_____________________ E.V. VENUGOPAL, J Date: 09.04.2025 ESP THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE E.V. VENUGOPAL CRIMINAL PETITION No.9920 OF 2023 Dated: 09.04.2025 ESP M. Alwal Reddy vs The State Of Telangana on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137378256/
